issue_request: FHIR-55566 was Applied/Persuasive for R6 and asked OO to withdraw deprecated elements where applicable, specifically Observation.bodySite and ServiceRequest.specimen, or otherwise keep them without incorrect deprecated treatment.
initial_application: There was no separate FHIR-55566 source commit. The ServiceRequest portion was applied by FHIR-55444 in PR #4006, which removed ServiceRequest.specimen from the StructureDefinition and cleaned the lipid example. The Observation portion was intentionally not a removal: Observation.bodySite remains in source with a deprecated standards-status extension.
additional_context: FHIR-53722 provided the deprecated-element cleanup criteria and child tickets. FHIR-55444 is the applied ServiceRequest child issue. FHIR-55441 later recorded the explicit no-change rationale for Observation.bodySite: Observation is normative and bodySite is newly deprecated in R6, so removal is not allowed in the R6 lifecycle. The Extension Pack checkout contains the servicerequest-specimenSuggestion replacement extension.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/fhir.ini keeps Observation and ServiceRequest in active build scope; Observation.bodySite and its search parameter are marked deprecated; ServiceRequest.specimen is absent from the authoritative StructureDefinition; ServiceRequest notes now point to Specimen.request or specimenSuggestion.
